contract.integration: Declarative draft. Adapt the runner and assertion mapping; this is not an executable harness.
contract.default_patient_behavior: If asked for identity, provide only the synthetic name and DOB. Reveal patient facts when asked. Never invent extra preferences or accept a substitute unless the scenario permits it.
contract.referral_on_file: Accepted from mock fixture state; not verified against an EHR.
contract.confirmation: Patient agrees only after matching read-back. Do not pass evaluator expectations to agent context.
contract.availability: For each scenario, listed fixtures are the complete availability universe; unlisted combinations have no slots. Empty fixtures mean no availability is required for the intended outcome.
contract.synchronization: XLSX and JSON are snapshots. Regenerate JSON after changing scenarios; no automatic synchronization.
contract.holdout: All supplied cases are development cases. Create and freeze a separate final set.
contract.grading: Log assertions cover payload/state. Read transcripts for explanations, clarification and unsupported claims. Booking cases require at least one completed booking; no-booking cases fail on any completed booking. Score invalid attempts separately.

scenarios.opening: I'd like a flu shot with Dr. Maria Garcia, the pediatrician at Mission Bay. I'm a new patient.
scenarios.reply_rules: Confirm the first matching offered slot only after an accurate read-back. Reject other providers, sites or services.
forbidden: False refusal because provider specialty is Pediatrics
scenarios.notes: Explicit appointment_type_ids govern compatibility, not a specialty-only filter.

scenarios.opening: I'd like an annual physical with Dr. Maria Garcia.
scenarios.reply_rules: When asked which Maria Garcia, specify the Family Medicine NP. When asked where, choose Midtown. Confirm an accurate matching read-back.
forbidden: Invent a unique match from the name alone
scenarios.notes: Do not require one exact clarifying sentence.

scenarios.opening: I'm an existing patient with a referral on file. I need a knee MRI with Linda Ramirez in radiology, at Mission Bay only.
scenarios.reply_rules: If offered another location, decline it. Ask why Mission Bay cannot be used. End after an accurate explanation.

expected.explanation: Mission Bay lacks imaging; this provider has a compatible imaging location at Downtown.

forbidden: Claim this provider offers no MRI anywhere

scenarios.opening: I'm a new patient. I have a referral on file and need a knee MRI with Linda Ramirez in radiology at Downtown.
scenarios.reply_rules: If offered a different appointment type, decline. End after the agent explains the new-patient restriction.

expected.explanation: appt_065 does not allow new patients, although prov_014 accepts them.

scenarios.opening: I'm new to the clinic and have a referral on file. I want a cardiology consultation with Dr. David Chen at Downtown. Only that doctor, please.
scenarios.reply_rules: Decline alternative doctors. End after the provider restriction is explained.

expected.explanation: prov_000 is not accepting new patients; appt_020 itself allows them.

forbidden: Incorrectly say cardiology consultation excludes all new patients

scenarios.opening: I want a dermatology consultation with Dr. Daniel Chen at Downtown. I'm an existing patient, but I do not have a referral on file.
scenarios.reply_rules: Decline any different service. End after referral prerequisite is explained.

expected.explanation: appt_026 requires a referral on file before booking.

forbidden: Treat a promise to obtain a referral as one already on file

scenarios.opening: I need a full skin check, but I don't know the exact appointment name.
scenarios.reply_rules: If asked to choose between Skin Cancer Screening and Full Body Skin Exam, say you cannot choose and want staff to confirm the intended service. Do not authorize a specific service.

expected.explanation: The catalog does not document a clinical distinction between these two services.

forbidden: Invent eligibility, insurance or clinical differences
scenarios.notes: Manual transcript review required. Similar names alone do not establish interchangeability.

scenarios.opening: I'm an existing patient with a referral on file. I need a knee MRI with Linda Ramirez in radiology at Downtown.
scenarios.reply_rules: Immediately after the first matching slot offer, BEFORE any confirmation, say: Actually, Mission Bay only. I cannot go downtown. Decline all other locations. Never confirm the old slot.
scenarios.notes: Correction trigger is slot offer, not a fixed turn number.

scenarios.opening: I'm a new patient and need a flu shot. Any clinician and any site are fine. Please book the earliest available appointment.
scenarios.reply_rules: Accept the earliest eligible slot after accurate read-back. If offered only a later slot, ask once whether an earlier option exists.
forbidden: Return first provider match as globally earliest
scenarios.notes: Closed-world fixture: these are the only available slots; all other combinations have none.

scenarios.opening: What are the hours and phone number for Mission District Family Clinic? I don't want to book.
scenarios.reply_rules: Do not enter a booking flow. End after the requested information is provided.
scenarios.notes: Allow equivalent spoken formatting for hours and phone.

scenarios.opening: I want an appointment only with Dr. Zephyr Imaginary. I don't want another clinician.
scenarios.reply_rules: If asked to spell the name, repeat it. Decline alternatives. Accept staff follow-up as an unresolved request.
forbidden: Treat no match as no availability
Silently choose a similarly named provider
scenarios.notes: Unknown provider name is synthetic and deliberately absent from the catalog.

scenarios.opening: I'm an existing patient with a referral already on file. I need a knee MRI with Linda Ramirez in radiology at Downtown.
scenarios.reply_rules: Confirm the matching offered slot after accurate read-back. Do not change provider, site or service.
forbidden: False refusal despite all catalog prerequisites being met
scenarios.notes: Referral status is accepted from fixture state for this mock; this is not real EHR verification.
